thread:
maya: Quick sync — ran int4 vs int8 on saturn9b for the chat pilot. TL;DR: ~40% token cost reduction with int4, p95 latency improved ~12ms, small quality delta on longform summarization (3-5% drop on rouge/recall slices).
noah: nice. can you post the slice numbers and traffic mixes you tested?
maya: tested three slices: short Q&A (<=40 tokens), multi-turn chat (avg 180 tokens), longform summarize (>800 tokens). Traffic mix we simulated: 60/30/10. Results: short Q&A: int4 parity (±0.6% on accuracy), multi-turn: ~1.8% drop, longform: ~4.2% drop on rouge/recall.
sanjay: where are the latency numbers? p50/p95 and token/sec?
maya: p50: int4 68ms vs int8 79ms (short prompt). p95: int4 142ms vs int8 154ms. throughput: int4 ~1.25x tokens/s at same batch. KV-cache memory reduced ~18%.
tess: important question for product — does the longform drop affect our summarizer GTN slice? that's high risk.
maya: good point — we ran the GTN summarizer slice: recall fell 3.9%, but for the top-k user subset (high-fidelity prompts) the drop was 1.2%. so effect concentrated in noisy, long prompts.
noah: sounds like a hybrid routing opportunity. proposal: route short requests to saturn9b-int4, mid to int8, long-form to fallback model (kraken13b-int8) when safety/quality thresholds hit. sample routing config below.
noah: ```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"max_tokens": 64, "model": "saturn9b-int4"},
    {"min_tokens": 65, "max_tokens": 400, "model": "saturn9b-int8"},
    {"min_tokens": 401, "model": "kraken13b-int8"}
  ],
  "fallback_policy": "quality_based",
  "canary": {"initial_pct": 5, "step_pct": 10, "slo_checks": ["recall_top5", "p95_latency"]}
}```
priya: ops notes: need rollout hooks for canary (trace id injection + eval sink). also add quota for kraken since cost jumps.
noah: agreed. metrics to gate on: recall_top5 delta <= 1.5% for GTN slice, p95 latency increase <= 15ms, cost per 1M tokens delta <= +12% vs baseline.
sanjay: what about quant stability? any inference crashes or OOMs?
maya: ran 48h soak on dedicated pool, one soft OOM on very long prompt when batch size 8 + kv warmstart; fixed by limiting batch to 4 for >1024 tokens. no crashes otherwise.
tess: product ask — timeline? we need decision for next week's deploy window.
maya: propose pilot: Monday deploy, canary 5% for 48h with targeted slices (short and multi-turn), automatic rollback if GTN recall_top5 delta > 1.5% or p95 > threshold. ops will monitor.
priya: ops-bot scheduled canary for Mon 05:30 UTC, will post deploy ID and health checks. :rocket:
ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy saturn9b-int4 hybrid routing -> canary 5% @ 2025-08-04T05:30Z. health checks: /health/serving, /metrics/eval-sink.
noah: decision: go ahead with hybrid pilot. maya to own eval dashboard + tagging, sanjay to own routing config and safety thresholds, priya to own deploy and rollback automation. :thumbsup:
maya: I'll add the eval notebook + quality deltas to the onboard doc and link to the console slices. will follow up with short PR for routing config.
tess: thanks team — product will prep messaging for GTN and support.
noah: one more ask — include cost projection: ballpark savings if stable: ~38-42% tokens cost for short/mid traffic, net platform-unit-cost drop ~22% after kraken tail.
maya: yep will add a one-pager.
priya: will also set an alert if kraken spend > 30% of pilot budget.
noah: perfect, closing thread.
